text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few days after I (somehow?) managed to turn in my summer homework, Eriko and Shizuru were about to host a banquet. One with a rather... unusual guest list.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事に（？）夏休みの宿題を提出してから数日後。
エリコとシズルによる、不思議な招待者たちが集まった
宴が開かれようとしていた。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Umm, well then, let’s begin by saying thank you for all your hard work on your homework...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
それじゃあ
ただいまより宿題お疲れさまと……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: ...and to offer our heartfelt apologies to the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE, we’re throwing this barbecue party!
text_block_list.orig_text:
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の皆さまごめんなさいを兼ねた
バーベキューパーティーを開催したいと思います。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Alright then...
text_block_list.orig_text: それでは……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru Eriko
text_block_list.text: Cheers!
text_block_list.orig_text: かんぱ～い！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheers!
text_block_list.orig_text: かんぱ～い！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: I just came because Eriko called me, and now I’m toasting... but what is this event even about? "Good job on the homework"? "Apology party"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
エリコに呼ばれるまま来て
乾杯までしてしまったが、
そもそもこの集まりはなんなのだ？
宿題お疲れさま？　
ごめんなさい？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Even we, who actually know what happened, don’t really get it. Why would you two go that far...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
事情を知ってるアタシたちのほうがよくわからないわよ。
なんであんなことやらかして……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: E-Eh...? D-Don't tell me, was Lady Eriko up to no good again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ひょっとしてエリコ様
またなんかやっちゃいました？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: So she really did something? What you just told me is at a level where she messed up so badly I can't even comment on it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんかやっちゃいました？
ってレベルじゃなくやらかしてて何も言えないよ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: EriEri and Shi-chan were really lively that day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの日のエリエリとシーちゃん
超ウケたね！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: When I got to school, I saw so many members of the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE collapsed on the ground. I was seriously shocked.
text_block_list.orig_text:
学校に着いたら【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の人たちが
倒れまくってるんだから
びっくりしたわよ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: So, if that really happened... why are there members of NIGHTMARE partying with us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
そんなことがあったのに
どうして
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の方々は
こちらにいらっしゃるんで？

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: Truth is, our Commander tore into us for not being able to handle just two girls...
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は
あの一件でたった二人を制圧できないとは何事かと
団長にこってり絞られてな……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: As an apology for the inconvenience we caused, we are participating in the training bootcamp for the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE.
text_block_list.orig_text:
迷惑を掛けたお詫びとして、
私たちが
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の訓練に参加しているのです。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: And since we were at it, we've also organized this party.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくだからってことで、
今回のパーティーにも呼んだんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Then... why invite us too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら
なんで我らまで？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: You're all friends who shared memories of this summer vacation with my Beloved {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた方は{0}様と
夏休みを楽しんだ仲間ですから。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ah, because of that beetle hunt night, huh...? That was really, how should I put it, an amazing night...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
あのカブトムシの夜か……
あれは本当に、
なんというか、
すごい夜でしたなー……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I read about it in your picture diary, {0}-kun. It looks like you had a really fun summer vacation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
{0}君の絵日記で読ませてもらったわ。
すごく楽しい夏休みを過ごせたみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: That sounds so nice! I wish I could've played with EriEri and the others more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいなー！　
うちももっと
エリエリたちと遊びたかったなー！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: That's... I agree. Next time, let’s all play together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは……
そうですね。
ぜひ
みんなで一緒に遊びましょう。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: But if we do, let’s keep it peaceful, okay? No more monster-infested forests!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度はもっと平和なのね！　
魔物巣食う森とかは勘弁だよ！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, of course... Wait, aahh?! They're running out of meat over there! Let's go and get some more, Eriko-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
もちろん……
って、
ああ！？
もうあっちお肉なくなりそう！
補充しに行くよ、
エリコちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Understood. Everyone, please enjoy yourself to the fullest. We'll be your hosts today. Well then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかりましたわ。
皆さまは存分に楽しんでください。
今日は
私たちがもてなしますので。
それでは。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: That Eriko... will be our host...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのエリコが
我らをもてなす、
だと……？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: A chance like this... might never happen again, so... let's have as much fun as we can today, Anna-taso!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなこと
もうないかもしれないから
今日は思いっきり楽しもう、
アンナたそ！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: ああ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...And that's when Lady Shizuru threw a big net on the monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこでシズル殿が
大きな投網を
バサーっと！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: My! So that's how you all caught that giant beetle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
それで大きなカブトムシを捕まえたのね！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: A beetle-like monster, to be precise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
正確には
カブトムシみたいな魔物、
だがな。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: What's more... you built a house on an uninhabited island, didn't you? That’s not just Whizboy-level... that’s Whizboy MAX!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
無人島で家作ったんでしょ？
家作れる
とか
ヒデサイマジでヒデサイすぎじゃね？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: No, I'm sure he's just exaggerating... Wait, seriously?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
さすがにそれは盛ってるでしょ……
って、
まさか。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Well, if it's Lady Eriko we're talking about... that's not so surprising...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
エリコ様なら
それくらいやってのけかねないね……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Those two really are something else...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの二人、
本当にただものじゃないわね……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Look. Everyone looks like they're having fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て。
みんなすごく楽しそう。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I never thought the day would come when I would have to entertain anyone other than my Beloved {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか
{0}様以外をもてなす日が来るなんて、
考えもしませんでしたわ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Thanks to this, we’re seeing a smile from him we never could’ve gotten on our own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげで
私たちだけじゃ見られない
弟くんの笑顔が見られてるよね。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: There are sides to my Beloved {0} we’d never see just by keeping him to ourselves... I’m sure there’s still so much we don’t know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
独占するだけでは見られない{0}様……
きっとほかにも
まだ私たちが知らないお姿があるのでしょうね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: No need to be sad, Eriko-chan. It just means we’ve still got so much of my little brother left to see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
嘆くことじゃないよ、
エリコちゃん。
まだまだたくさんの弟くんが見られるってことだからね！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Seeing my Beloved {0} from a little distance like this is also wonderful...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして少し離れたところから見る{0}様も
また素敵ですわ……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I want to see more and more sides of my little brother from now on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからもっともっと
いろんな弟くんを見てみたいな。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: He's lovely from afar, but what's even more wonderful is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
遠くから見るあのおかたも素敵ですが、
それ以上に素晴らしいのは……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: ...Seeing my little brother right up close! and personal!
text_block_list.orig_text: 一番近くで見る弟くん！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. I have no intention of ever giving that up, but sometimes it might not be a bad idea to take a step back like this and look at things from a different perspective.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ですわ。
それを譲る気はありませんが、
でもたまにはこうして一歩引いて
眺めるのも
悪くないかもしれません。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまには、
ね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: If he's the one calling us... it can't be helped, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
呼ばれちゃったら
仕方ないよね？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I won't back down from being the closest to him, though... Kuskus...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですね。
一番近くは譲りませんけどね……
クスクス……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I won't lose either!
text_block_list.orig_text: 負けないよ！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru Eriko
text_block_list.text: LITTLE BROTHER! MY BELOVED!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
弟く～ん！
あなた様～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As summer comes to an end, Eriko and Shizuru, through {0}, discover something precious -- and grow just a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏の終わり。
エリコとシズルは{0}を通して
大切なものを見つけ、ほんの少しだけ成長するのであった。
